info.name: Automation Anywhere API Task Execution AccessDetails Deployments API

items.docs: Deploys an automation bot from the public workspace to one or more Bot Runner devices. Supports unattended deployment (to devices linked to a specified user), attended deployment (to any device accessible to the user), and headless deployment (to On-Demand Bot Runner devices). Returns a deploymentId that can be used to monitor the execution status. Input variables can be passed at runtime via the botInput field.
